experiments.study_type: fDTH-EAE focal delayed-type hypersensitivity model of experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis
experiments.procedure_text: fDTH-EAE rats with acute inflammation were administered EC2319 or saline on days 0, 3, 7, and 10 and sacrificed on day 14 for PET/CT and ex vivo analyses.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: fDTH-EAE rats with acute inflammation were administered EC2319 (750 nmol/kg/day) or saline on days 0, 3, 7, and 10 after disease activation and were used for 68 Ga-FOL, histology, and immunofluorescence analyses on day 14.
experiments.animal_counts_evidence: Male Lewis rats (2-3 months, n = 60, 270 ± 23 g)
experiments.test_system_evidence: in vivo imaging was performed... sacrificed for ex vivo gamma counting... used to evaluate the in vitro binding

endpoints.label: neuroinflammation
endpoints.evidence: focal delayed-type hypersensitivity model of experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis

endpoints.label: biodistribution of 68Ga-FOL
endpoints.evidence: ex vivo gamma counting of excised tissues

endpoints.label: plasma cytokine levels
endpoints.evidence: Plasma levels of interferon γ (IFN-γ) and interleukins IL-1β, IL-4, IL-6, and IL-10 were measured

experiments.exposure_evidence: subcutaneously administered with EC2319 (750 nmol/kg/day, 400 ± 100 μL in saline) in the nuchal area 0, 3, 7, and 10 days after lesion activation.
experiments.notes: Includes acute and chronic phase cohorts, and healthy control rats.
